name: Promotion of Tiatr Related Activities
benefit:
##### ***Financial Support Categories***

- ***Category A1*** ***- Konkani Musical Shows:*** Financial assistance for organizing shows with minimum 14 songs including duets, trios, quartets, choral songs, solos and at least 2 comedy skits.- ***Category A2*** ***- Singing Competitions:*** Financial assistance for organizing competitions with minimum 15 participants singing newly composed kantaram.-
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a cultural institution or individual organizing tiatr-related activities in Goa. - The applicant must organize activities in their respective villages or towns. - The applicant must ensure the program is staged free of charge to the public. - The applicant must agree to acknowledge Tiatr Academy of Goa collaboration in all promotional materials. - The applicant must ensure content does not contain adverse remarks against governments, individuals, institutions, or content against caste, creed, and religion. ***For Konkani Musical Shows*** - The applicant must ensure lyrics are newly composed and not recorded on any Audio/Video/Digital Versatile Disc Albums. - The applicant must arrange a band with minimum 5 instruments including drums, keyboard, guitar and 2 blowing instruments. - The applicant must organize minimum 14 songs including interactive duets, duos, trios, quartets/quintets, choral songs, solos and at least 2 comedy skits. - The applicant must submit typed lyrics and skit scripts at least 30 days in advance. ***For Singing Competitions*** - The applicant must ensure minimum 15 participants. - The applicant must ensure participants sing newly composed kantaram not recorded on any Audio/Video/Digital Versatile Disc Albums. - The applicant must arrange a band with minimum 5 instruments including drums, keyboard, guitar and 2 blowing instruments. - The applicant must provide competition rules to Tiatr Academy of Goa. - The applicant must submit typed song lyrics at least 8 days in advance. ***For Other Competitions*** - The applicant must submit application form at least 30 days in advance. ***For Celebrating Tiatr Artists*** - The applicant must focus on prominent tiatr artists such as actors, singers, writers. - The applicant must submit application form at least 15 days in advance.
